documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing the INR 1,000 Crore revenue milestone for the first time with revenues reaching INR 1,053.19 Crore. The operational improvement was driven by the commercial commissioning of the Alu-Zinc coating line, augmentation of the existing colour-coated line, and a strategic shift towards value-added coated steel products. Management outlined strong future revenue targets of INR 1,500 Crore for FY 2026-27 and approximately INR 3,000 Crore for FY 2028-29 following planned backward integration into a cold-rolling mill. The company maintained a debt-light balance sheet with no long-term debt and upgraded credit ratings. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for FY 2024-25, highlighting revenue of H584.18 Crore and a net profit of H11.70 Crore.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested H85 Crore to fund the first expansion programme comprising the addition of a new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 110,800 TPA through internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year. This investment of H85 Crore was funded through internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The company undertook a second expansion programme of H40 Crore for adding a new colour coating manufacturing line to enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is poised to double its installed capacity through net worth.
capex_expansion.quote: At Manaksia Steels, we are poised to double our installed capacity through net worth.

capex_expansion.claim: The management is excited to introduce a new product, Alu-Zinc, during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The management is excited to introduce a new product, Alu-Zinc, an alloy consisting of 55% Aluminium and 45% Zinc on cold rolled strip, during the year.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 due to a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's new colour coating manufacturing line is expected to enhance total manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

capital_allocation.claim: The expansion programme is expected to be funded through net worth.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the second expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
